rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese noun for a meeting or organized gathering.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jau5 go3 wui6

rows.note: Use this for the occasion or encounter when people meet, including an accidental meeting.

example.english: I ran into an old classmate on the street yesterday—it was a very unexpected meeting.
example.traditional: 我噚日喺街度同以前個同學見面，真係好意外。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 tung4 ji5 cin4 go3 tung4 hok6 gin3 min6 zan1 hai6 hou2 ji3 ngoi6
